eyebrow: Search for Common Ground · Imagine If: Tin Can Phone · New York, Aug 2026 · One-stranger short
title: Imagine If:
title_short: Tin Can · Courtney sings · Let It Resonate
headline: A stranger sings into a tin can phone in Central Park, and for the first time her nerves go away.
story: After the tin can talk, Kalindi asks Courtney to sing. She is a classical singer and she sings right there on the path, eyes closed.
Then she says it: she thought she would be scared, but this is the first time she let it go and let it resonate. The song carries the video. One person, about 32 seconds.
do: Text on frame 1: “A STRANGER. A TIN CAN. ONE SONG.” Already on screen at 0:00.
Open on her singing, eyes closed (764_3906 0:35–2:25).
Let the song breathe: at least 8 seconds of clean singing in the middle.
End on “let it resonate like right here in this moment”.
Use different seconds of the song than the Tin Cans montage uses for its opening.
dont: Do not use 764_3906 2:33–3:10 or any of 764_3907. Private story. Never in any cut.
No lines from her tin can talk (that is The Space in Between video).
No music bed under the singing. Her voice is the music.
No name super. No place name.

tech: Picture: 764 MXF files, 16:9. The Monday brief says 1920×1080, 23.98 fps. Our probe could only read the proxies (960×540, 23.976 fps, several mono audio tracks). Check the MXF in the NLE before you set the timeline.
1080×1920 at 23.976 fps. Same as the source. No conversion.

A 9:16 crop of 1080p is 608 px wide, so it is already upscaled 1.78×. Keep punch-ins at 110% or less. Sharpen lightly. 764_3906 and 764_3908 are close shots of Courtney: crop centre. 764_3908 is a low angle into the sun: pull the highlights down a little.
Audio is in the camera. The MXF has several mono tracks. Solo each track and use the one with the clear voice. We did not measure the channels here.
−14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP peak. Any music 18–20 dB under the voice.
Royal-blue box #1E6FD6, white text, floating over the speaker. Max 2 lines. Keep the bottom 20% clear.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, about 16 Mbps. One file. 9:16 only. Deliver to Frame.io → Ready for Review.
checklist: Write “Search for Common Ground”: capital S, small “for”. Never SFCG, CGLA or a Preemptive Love logo on screen.
The hook text is already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on. No logo, title card, name or fade at 0:00.
Captions match the audio word for word. Keep the speaker’s own grammar.
No camera-shutter sounds. Every jump cut is covered.
No animation in the middle (Kalindi: “it was inauthentic”).
No name and no place name on screen.
End card: Search for Common Ground lockup + sfcg.org. Nothing under it.
Cut from the MXF in RAW, never from the proxy. 9:16 only.
Nothing from 764_3906 2:33–3:10 and nothing from 764_3907, sound or picture.
No music bed. The singing is clean, no ducking under captions.
The opening song phrase is not the one the Tin Cans montage opens on.

decisions.b: The end card reads sfcg.org. Search is still building the Imagine If landing page (Yana owns it). One end-card pass across the batch when the link exists.
